label: Alien species
blurb: Extraterrestrials of every shape: greys, reptilians, insectoids, crystal beings and living gel, working the docks, bars and embassies of a busy galactic spaceport. Humans need not apply.
context: science fiction alien character, a non-human extraterrestrial (not a human in makeup), in alien clothing

nearhuman.label: Near-human alien
nearhuman.features: subtly alien features: long pointed ears and faint patterned markings along the temples and jaw

grey.label: Grey alien
grey.features: a large smooth bulbous head, a narrow pointed chin, tiny nostril slits, a small lipless mouth and long thin fingers

reptilian.label: Reptilian alien
reptilian.features: fine overlapping scales, a flat nose with slit nostrils, a heavy ridged brow and a crest of short spines along the head
reptilian.hair: a crest of short spines in place of hair

insectoid.label: Insectoid alien
insectoid.features: a hard glossy chitin exoskeleton, two long feathered antennae and small mandibles either side of the mouth
insectoid.hair: a smooth chitin-plated head with no hair

amphibian.label: Amphibian alien
amphibian.features: smooth damp skin, gill slits along the neck, a wide lipless mouth and webbed fingers
amphibian.hair: a smooth hairless head with a soft fin ridge down the middle

trieye.label: Three-eyed alien
trieye.features: a third eye in the middle of the forehead, smooth skin and small ear holes in place of ears

crystal.label: Crystalline alien
crystal.features: a body of faceted translucent crystal with a soft glowing light shining through the chest and face
crystal.hair: a cluster of jagged crystal spikes in place of hair

sylvan.label: Plantfolk alien
sylvan.features: bark-textured skin, thin vines curling along the arms and small flowering buds on the shoulders
sylvan.hair: a crown of broad leafy fronds in place of hair

stoneback.label: Stone-hided alien
stoneback.features: thick craggy stone-like hide plates, a heavy brow and a broad blunt jaw
stoneback.hair: a craggy stone-plated head with no hair

gel.label: Gel alien
gel.features: a translucent gelatinous body holding a humanoid shape, with small bubbles drifting inside
gel.hair: a smooth rounded gel head with no hair

hobbies: trying every dish in the spaceport market
singing in frequencies humans can't hear
tending a tank of glowing spores
watching old human films for research
keeping a tiny pet from the home world
quirks: tilting {poss} head at every human joke
tasting the air when meeting someone
standing far too close when talking
refusing to sit with {poss} back to a window
collecting other species' names in a notebook
calling everyone by their full name
goals: finding a way back to {poss} home world
being the first of {poss} kind accepted on the council
opening a restaurant for every species
finding the rest of {poss} lost clutch-mates
ending the old feud between two species
earning citizenship on a peaceful world
decoding a signal older than the stars around it
seeing an ocean on another planet
peeves: human food that is mostly salt
translator devices that get idioms wrong
being asked to take them to the leader
loud music in the docking bay
accessories: a small floating translator drone at the shoulder
a crystal pendant that glows in a rhythm
a breathing apparatus clipped to the collar
a ceremonial ring of polished alien metal
a sling holding a strange small alien pet
a curved blade in a jewelled sheath
a star map projector worn on the wrist
a woven sash of iridescent fibre
an ornate energy pistol in a hip holster
a trade token on a chain
default_outfits: a high-collared flowing robe of iridescent fabric, a woven sash and soft wrapped boots
a fitted utility bodysuit with glowing seam lines, a belt of pouches and soft boots
a layered traveller's poncho of alien silk over a simple tunic and wrapped boots
_tables: The next entries replace the shared tables in common.json for this setting only (same shape): space-age eyewear, no dye, and marks that read on any of the species (no fur, no hair). Each species states its own skin and eyes; the ones with no hair state fixed 'hair' text and 'facial_hair': '' (see roll.py).

glasses.label: a glowing heads-up lens over one eye

distinguishing.label: faintly glowing bioluminescent spots along the neck
a ritual scar across one cheek
a small translator implant at the temple
a chipped piece missing from one side of the head
glowing clan markings on the forehead
a metallic ring piercing at the brow
an unusual shimmer to the skin
an old burn scar from a starship fire
